dates.title: URI Admission - First-Year Student Admission (deadlines, test policy, requirements)

intl.title: URI Admission - International Student Admission (deadlines, English proficiency, scholarships)

fs.title: URI International Admission Quick Facts 2024-2025 (PDF, prior-year fact sheet)

test_policy.notes: URI is test-optional; SAT/ACT scores are not required and are superseded by a holistic review. The international page encourages submitting scores if seeking merit scholarships. 6-year Pharm.D. applicants: SAT/ACT optional but recommended.

requirements.notes: Common App, $65 fee (or waiver), official high school transcript (STARS Record only for US-system schools), essay, one letter of recommendation (two for Pharmacy). International applicants also send certified English translations of non-English documents, official English test scores directly from the testing agency, and a gap-year paragraph if applicable. Supplemental essay for Honors, Nursing, Pharmacy and Talent Development only. URI does not offer individual interviews.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding), fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Decision in early December. Enrollment and housing deposits due Feb. 1 (or within two weeks of a financial aid award if aid was requested). The pages give no year, so the fall 2027 entry cycle is assumed.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding) and priority scholarship consideration
deadlines.notes: Decision by Jan. 31; deposit due May 1. Dec. 1 is also the priority scholarship deadline. Same date on the international page. No year is printed, so fall 2027 entry is assumed.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision / international fall semester deadline
deadlines.notes: International page lists 'Fall Semester (September): February 1' for first-year international applicants, the same date as the domestic Regular Decision deadline; decisions by Mar. 31, deposit due May 1. The prior-year (2024-25) international fact sheet printed June 1 for regular decision, so the current page was used. No year is printed, so fall 2027 entry is assumed. URI has sometimes extended its regular deadline in past cycles, so confirm on the site.

deadlines.label: FAFSA priority filing date
deadlines.notes: Applies to U.S. citizens/eligible noncitizens; international students are not eligible for need-based aid (Common Data Set priority date Mar. 1).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants who attended a secondary or post-secondary school where the language of instruction is English may be exempt from an English proficiency exam, depending on their English grades (AP, IB, O level, A-level, GCSE, American curriculum) and SAT/ACT scores if submitted; decided case by case. Scores must be sent directly by the testing agency.

english.notes: From the prior-year (2024-25) international fact sheet; the current international page no longer prints an old-scale (0-120) number for general programs. 6-year Pharm.D.: 100.

Current page prints 'TOEFL iBT: minimum score of 4.5' (Pharm.D. 5.0) without naming the scale; 4.5 is on the new 1-6 scale. The same page also prints a Pharm.D. TOEFL minimum of 100 in another section.
PTE Academic or PTE Express. 6-year Pharm.D.: 68.
Cambridge English Advanced, scores 176-184 (Pharm.D. 185-190). The page also accepts the Eiken test (completion of Pre-1).

aid.notes: No need-based aid for international students. All applicants are automatically considered for partial-tuition merit scholarships through the Common App (no separate application), renewable yearly with a minimum GPA; they do not cover room, board or fees. Qualified students have historically received $8,750 to $15,000 per year. Dec. 1 is the priority scholarship date. In the Common Data Set, 126 nonresidents received the college's own non-need aid, average $26,565.

majors.notes: Higher English minimums (TOEFL 5.0 on the new scale, IELTS 7.0, Duolingo 125), two recommendation letters (one from a science or math teacher) and a pharmacy interest statement are required. Capacity and admit rate are not published on the pages read.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read.

tier_notes.general: Our estimate: a 75% admit rate (74% for international applicants) and a 1210 SAT median among the 23% who submit place URI just above the open-access D tier, like other large flagship publics.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Our estimate: URI's marine biology and oceanography are well regarded (Graduate School of Oceanography), placed in the 41-100 range.
tier_notes.nursing: Our estimate: an established BSN program at a flagship; no ranking cited.
